    CITY OF GALLUP CONTRACTS FOR POWER POLE, ATTACHMENT INSPECTION

    By Gallup Sun PublishingNovember 10, 2026No Comments1 Min Read
    Facebook Twitter Pinterest LinkedIn Tumblr WhatsApp Email
    Share
    Facebook Twitter LinkedIn WhatsApp Pinterest Email

    Staff Reports

    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 0:48
    Instaread

    As part of the City of Gallup Electric’s “Pole Health Check and Attachment Audit,” crews from Osmose Utilities, Inc, — a service partner of City of Gallup Electric Department — will conduct inspections, and testing on power poles across City of Gallup Electric Service Area operating starting in Novemember and February.

    This routine maintenance work is required so the city can assess the strength of the power pole(s) to ensure continued safety and electric service reliability.

    Osmose Utilities, Inc. technicians are under contract with the City and authorized to perform pole inspections. All Osmose technicians will carry identification. When performing pole inspections, Osmose Utilities, Inc. technicians will be operating vehicles with the Osmose logo.

    For any questions or concerns, contact the City of Gallup Utilities Department at (505) 863-1200.
